checks.scenario: Use blocked, allowed, and blocked scripted decisions together with distinguishable payment outcomes.
assertions: Allowed orders consume exactly the next payment outcome.
No reservation or persisted record leaks from a blocked order.

checks.scenario: Exercise missing customers, suspended customers, missing products, insufficient stock, fraud blocks, and payment declines.
assertions: Screening occurs only after existing domain validation.
Every failure returns its documented code.
A later valid order succeeds without corrupted stock or decision order.
